info.title: Workloom API
info.description: The operational API for a Workloom installation. Every operation the application performs is available here; the user interface uses the same service layer.

apiKey.description: An API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer wl_live_...`. A key can never exceed the permissions of the user who owns it, evaluated per request.
